name: garmin-personal-api
description: Let Claude read your own Garmin Connect data (sleep, HRV, heart rate, activities and more) with Garmin's official Personal API key. Read-only.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to **your own** Garmin Connect data through Garmin's official [Personal API](https://developer.garmin.com/gc-developer-program/personal/personal-api/). No password, no scraping: you paste a Personal API key you created yourself in Garmin Connect, and it stays on your computer.

**What Claude can read:** sleep (stages, score, overnight respiration), HRV, all-day heart rate, resting heart rate, SpO2, Body Battery, stress, steps, activities, weight, fitness age, hydration, food log, heart rate zones and menstrual cycle data.

**What it can't do:** it is read-only, so it cannot create or send workouts to your watch. Garmin's Personal API also does not include training readiness, training status, training load, VO2max, badges or gear.

**Setup:** in Garmin Connect on the web, open Settings → Personal API Key → Create Key, copy the key, and paste it here.

Unofficial project by Garmin School. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Garmin. Not medical advice.

api_key.title: Garmin Personal API key
api_key.description: Create it in Garmin Connect on the web: Settings → Personal API Key → Create Key. Garmin shows it only once, so paste it here straight away.
